request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This counts public classes, public module-level functions, and public methods found in the code-symbol and file catalogs. It restricts to files inside the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package, excludes anything under that package's tests folder and any file flagged as a test, and keeps only symbols whose names do not begin with an underscore and that are marked public. Nested classes and nested functions are filtered out via the qualified-name check, and the three kinds are reported in a fixed order, showing zero when a kind has no matches.

AND f.file_id NOT LIKE 'auto!_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' ESCAPE '!' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND s.is_public = TRUE AND s.name NOT LIKE '!_%' ESCAPE '!' AND s.kind IN ('class', 'function', 'method') AND ((s.kind IN ('class', 'function') AND s.qualname = s.name) OR (s.kind = 'method' AND s.qualname NOT LIKE '!_%' ESCAPE '!')) GROUP BY s.kind) SELECT k.kind, COALESCE(c.public_count, 0) AS public_count FROM expected_kinds AS k LEFT JOIN counts AS c ON k.kind = c.kind ORDER BY CASE k.kind WHEN 'class' THEN 1 WHEN 'function' THEN 2 WHEN 'method' THEN 3 END;
